prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / character costume and prop edit. Create ONE revised 鲸声守望 Q版 character concept sheet from the attached APPROVED reference. Preserve its character identity, round big-headed 2.5-head-tall CHIBI proportions, blue whale-girl appearance, muted cool painterly style, navy/ivory palette, dark maritime lighthouse atmosphere, and the sheet composition. The user's goal is to make her actual job immediately legible: she examines community posts and comments, checks details and records a questionable item. Express this through concrete costume details, facial accessory and an active pose, not merely a label.
Keep the same square board: full-body main character on left two thirds; one enlarged matching simplified woodcut head-and-collar icon on the right, with two small head-only dark/light contrast versions below. The only typography remains the restrained title 鲸声守望 at upper left. Same muted navy and cool gray textured thick paint, a small old-gold warm light, aged ivory paper on the right. No bright saturated commercial anime aesthetic. Keep the large round face, big but calm matte blue-gray eyes, tiny neutral mouth, short limbs, small hands, lateral WHALE-FIN ears with pale undersides, long dark blue hair with faded cyan tips, curved blue ahoge and recognizable white wave headband. She remains cute in shape and solemn in mood. Do not age her into a realistic adult or change to long fashion proportions.
CHANGES THAT SHOW THE JOB:
1. A thin aged-gold circular MONOCLE over her left eye (viewer-right), transparent glass, the eye clearly visible and normally positioned beneath it. One simple delicate retaining chain. It is an observation lens, not an eyepatch, mechanical eye or opaque device. Match this monocle on every icon.
2. Keep the short navy cape but simplify ornamental trim. Under it a practical off-white standing-collar blouse and fitted short navy jacket. Replace the oversized neck bow with a small clearly WHALE-TAIL-shaped aged-gold collar clasp. Add a modest flat chest badge showing a simple SPEECH BUBBLE with a MAGNIFYING GLASS motif; make the chest badge visible beside the clipboard. A small pen pocket at her waist. Avoid police, military or judicial insignia; this is a community discussion observer and reviewer.
3. Her main hand-held prop is now a compact CLIPBOARD, angled partially toward the viewer. The sheet shows three clearly separated COMMENT / CHAT BUBBLE rows drawn as simple gray line glyphs. Exactly ONE row is circled in restrained AMBER with a small annotation tick beside it, visually meaning 'this specific comment needs checking'. The other two rows remain unmarked. No real readable comments or tiny fake writing. One little hand supports the board and the other holds a short pencil pointing at the circled row. Exactly two hands, clear plausible grip, no extra fingers or arms. Expression attentive, eyes directed between the record board and the viewer, chin slightly lowered and eyes gently raised; calm scrutiny, not anger or smug superiority.
4. Move the small antique brass LANTERN to a secure simple hook at the side of her waist, hanging free of her hands. It emits a dim warm glow over the cloak hem. It is a secondary symbol, the observation lens and record board are the main job cues. Keep the navy skirt, opaque white socks, round navy boots and curled whale tail with pale underside. Hair should frame the character without covering the clipboard or badge.
RIGHT ICON: same ROUND CHIBI head and short collar, same monocle, white headband, large fin ears and curved ahoge. Bold navy-and-ivory woodcut-like masses with a small restrained gold monocle circle. Add one small SPEECH BUBBLE marker at the lower-right edge of the head icon, composed of a single simple recognizable outline, not a dense multi-symbol badge. Simplify hair into a few large locks, make the face occupy most of the square, eliminate delicate hatching and hair strands. Two reduced copies below on navy and ivory backgrounds. These are HEADS ONLY, not full-body figures. Preserve the approved calm character identity and avoid adding new unrelated accessories or changing art style. Overall image should read as 'a little whale-girl carefully reviewing a discussion and recording evidence' at first glance.
